Community action: Kevin O'Brien — formally request a portfolio expansion meeting with david chen (or his successor/interim manager if david has departed) to add small business lending and personal loan origination to kevin's active scope. the nmls mortgage pathway is 8 months out. small business and personal loan work is something kevin can do with existing credentials now. frame it as: auto volume is structurally declining, kevin has the compliance and credit skills, the bank has sba products and personal loan products that are underutilized, and kevin wants to be the originator who covers that gap starting this month. this is not a request for reassignment — it is a request to expand the current role rather than wait for attrition to force a move.
People around you are stressed: Rick Tanner. The mood is tense.

You Follow up directly with Linda Park on the tick 7 outreach — not a second ask, but a brief, professional note acknowledging the RoboRide expansion as the context for my outreach. Frame it: I reached out last week because I saw this coming, and this week confirms the trajectory. The point is not to say 'I told you so' — it is to demonstrate that I understand the market with precision, that I can be useful to anyone in the regional financial services space who needs someone who can read disruption early. Ask specifically whether she has heard of any credit union, community bank, or insurance-adjacent finance roles in the region — and offer to share the scenario models I built at First Community as context for any conversation she facilitates. This is active relationship management, not passive networking.. Savings dropped by $6,961.
